qualification: N08 bounded planned-terminal-stop measurement: source final dynamics guard, fresh same-run corridor/landing admission,0.25m extra tracking/hold margin and live tracking watchdog are mandatory. Return is stationary EGO yaw reorientation followed by forward-only EGO planning; reversing is forbidden. Arbitrary moving cancellation braking is not authorized by this protocol.

n08_braking_trial.prior_basis: Historical server-room-04/05/06 position-setpoint versus PX4 feedback, at actual horizontal speeds<=0.15m/s, showed max tracking errors0.1291/0.1385/0.1435m. Use0.15m watchdog within unchanged0.25m hold/tracking margin. Planned spline decelerates before its endpoint with zero terminal velocity/acceleration; evaluate independent truth after this controlled terminal stop. Historical model camera mount differed; current measurements are required and this is not a hardware guarantee.
n08_braking_trial.cancel_stop_distance_envelope_basis: 0.50m finite-sample candidate for the measured forward low-speed caller-cancel trial only. It matches the existing evaluator envelope and is sized against the EGO stop-target cap of 0.45m plus the existing 0.05m forward route-tube allowance; reference-anchor offset means this is not a proven upper bound. The same value is consumed by pre-enable and airborne raw-map corridor admission and the independent evaluator. The exact replacement spline and terminal hold still require EGO's live raw-map certificate. It is not a general braking guarantee or a radial increase to the body clearance.
